freeze.encoding: integer nanoseconds from header.stamp.to_nsec(); list hash = sha256 of comma-joined sorted ns

missing_raw_scans.definition: raw scans in the injected bag with no pose within the pairing rule; outside the paired cohort
missing_raw_scans.note: listed separately; outside the paired cohort

freeze.reference_definition: FULL clean-run cloud in its own world frame, no cap; every distance is a local 8-NN PCA point-to-plane distance

converted_scans.what: converted = filtered copy of the same bag; only the /velodyne_points payload changes, every other topic is copied byte for byte

control_poses_out.what: unfiltered replay, used only as the reproducibility control for the host pipeline

host.isolation: private ROS master on a free port; the wrapper kills only its own PIDs

superseded_by_ns_boundary.why: the float 6-dp boundary put the first injected scan in the healthy prefix; primary/subset/prefix were 445/259/133 and are now 446/252/132
superseded_by_ns_boundary.status: kept for the record only; do not cite

C0.label: REAL_HOST
C0.label_note: host poses as archived; contaminated scans; no repair

C1.label: OFFLINE_CONSTRUCT
C1.label_note: clean-run poses carried into the injected frame by the pre-onset SE(3); contaminated scans kept -- oracle/proxy consistency control, not GT accuracy

C2.label: ORACLE_CEILING
C2.label_note: oracle removal of the injector's sheet inside the absolute window only; does NOT restore the occluded background, so not a general optimal-map bound; upper bound for this injected data only

C3.label: OFFLINE_NATIVE_REESTIMATION
C3.label_note: shipped point-mixture filter (no window, no clean bag) + FAST-LIVO2 re-estimated poses on the filtered bag; not called deployable
